From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Subject: VP/CTO alignment: lock a 30-min window to unblock pilot

Hi Ava — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum on the pilot: 

- What we agreed on: narrow scope pilot focused on inference latency and cost for your search-rerank workflow.
- Outstanding: exec alignment (VP/CTO) to confirm SLOs and signing authority, and a technical deep-dive to finalize integration points and data flow.

To unblock internal approvals on both sides, can we lock a 30-minute VP/CTO intro (you + Markus; our VP Karthik + Sean / Marissa) next week? Prefer a short, focused alignment — agenda: 10m intros, 10m pilot acceptance criteria, 10m run-of-play for pilot timeline.

Attached: discovery notes and a half-page pilot outline that we used in the call (redwood-discovery-notes.pdf, pilot-outline.xlsx).

Proposed windows (UK-friendly but US overlap):
- Tue 8/15 10:00–10:30 PT / 18:00–18:30 BST
- Wed 8/16 08:30–09:00 PT / 16:30–17:00 BST

If those don't work, send 2 slots that do and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks,
Sean
--
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachment: redwood-discovery-notes.pdf (summary, 3 pages)
Attachment: pilot-outline.xlsx (tabbed: objectives, success criteria, timelines)

Hi Sean — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments, both look useful. I looped in Markus (our CTO) — he'll need the 10-minute technical rundown around how caching/batching will impact our 512-token median requests.

For availability: Markus is tight but can do either of these windows in PT next week:
- Tue 8/15 10:00–10:30 PT (works)
- Thu 8/17 09:00–09:30 PT (backup)

I can confirm once Markus approves, but he’s indicated the Tue slot is preferable.

Quick Q: can you include a short note in the agenda about expected token cost delta vs our baseline? (1–2 bullets is fine). Also appreciate the pilot outline — we’ll review with procurement next week.

Best,
Ava

Great — thanks for the quick turn. I’ll tentatively hold Tue 8/15 10:00–10:30 PT on our side and send a calendar invite pending Markus confirmation.

Per your ask: two bullets for the agenda on token cost so Markus and procurement can see the delta:
- Expected per-token delta vs current baseline: ~+12–18% for identical prompt length due to additional reranking passes; caching can reduce this by ~6–9% on repeat prefixes.
- Pilot instrumentation: we’ll provide token-level cost telemetry + a 1-week cost projection based on sample traffic if you share a 7-day sample workload (CSV).

If Markus prefers the Thu backup we can move it — just let us know. I’ll draft the invite with the short agenda and attach the pilot-outline.xlsx to the event.

Thanks,
Sean
